heading: Front Stabilizer Bar
text:
SA-49
SUSPENSION AND AXLE - FRONT LOWER BALL JOIN f
INSTALLATION
1. INSTALL LOWER BALL JOINi
(a) Install the lower ball joint and tighten the nut.
Torque: 103 N-m (1,050 kgf-cm, 76 ft-lbf)
(b) Install a new cotter pin.
If the holes for the cotter pin are not aligned, tighten the nut fur­
ther up to 60 Q .
2. INSTALL STEERING KNUCKLE WITH AXLE HUB
R088S() (See page SA-16)
3. CHECK ABS SPEED SENSOR SIGNAL
(See page D1-276)
4. CHECK FRONT WHEEL ALIGNMENT
(See page SA-4)
